definition_zh: 癌；癌症；（社会性）痼疾、毒瘤；巨蟹座
definition_en: a disease in which cells grow uncontrollably and spread; also an evil spreading through a society, or the zodiac sign
core_image: 一只螃蟹用螯钳死死夹住组织不放：增生蔓延、钳住不松的病
scene: 体检报告摊在桌上，全家人围着那行小字沉默不语。The scan showed the cancer had not spread beyond the lung.
sceneCN: 这里 cancer 是「癌症」（第 1 个义项：细胞失控增生的疾病）；句意是扫描显示癌症尚未扩散到肺部以外。

derivatives.zh: 由名词加形容词后缀构成，义为「癌的；似癌扩散的」
同根借词，义为「致癌物」（经希腊语 karkinos 同源）
由 cancer 加学科后缀构成，义为「癌学」（罕用）

senses.title: A malignant tumor disease
senses.definition: a disease in which abnormal cells divide without control and invade nearby tissue
senses.definitionCN: 异常细胞失控分裂并侵袭周围组织的疾病
senses.example: Early detection raises the survival rate for most cancers.
senses.exampleCN: 早发现能提高大多数癌症的生存率。
senses.why: The swollen veins around a tumor were said to look like a crab's legs gripping flesh.
senses.whyCN: 据说肿瘤周围肿胀的血管形似螃蟹的腿，紧扣住血肉不放。

senses.title: A spreading social evil
senses.definition: something harmful that spreads destructively through a society or group
senses.definitionCN: 在社会或群体中蔓延扩散、破坏性强的祸害
senses.example: Corruption became a cancer eating the institution.
senses.exampleCN: 腐败成了吞噬这个机构的毒瘤。
senses.why: Unchecked growth is the essence of cancer, so any spreading harm borrows the image.
senses.whyCN: 「失控增生」是癌的本质，因此一切蔓延的祸害都可借用这幅图景。

senses.title: The zodiac sign and constellation
senses.definition: the fourth sign of the zodiac, or the faint northern constellation of the same name
senses.definitionCN: 黄道十二宫的第四宫，或同名的北天暗弱星座
senses.example: The sun enters Cancer in late June.
senses.exampleCN: 太阳在六月下旬进入巨蟹宫。
senses.why: The crab shape named both the constellation and, through Greek medicine, the disease itself.
senses.whyCN: 螃蟹的形状既命名了星座，又经希腊医学的转手命名了这种病。

intro.en: Cancer is simply the Latin word for crab; Greek physicians applied it to tumors because of the crab-leg look of swollen vessels, and the word passed unchanged into English.
intro.cn: cancer 就是拉丁语「螃蟹」；希腊医生因肿瘤周围血管形似蟹腿而以此命名，随后原形进入英语。

items.en: The root *kar- / *ker- refers to hard structures, seen in Greek karkinos, crab.
items.cn: 词根 *kar- / *ker- 指坚硬结构，见于希腊语 karkinos（螃蟹）。

items.en: Greek karkinos meant crab; Hippocratic texts used it for hard tumors, and karkinoma gives carcinoma.
items.cn: 希腊语 karkinos 意为螃蟹；希波克拉底文献用它指硬性肿瘤，karkinoma 衍生出 carcinoma（癌）。

items.en: Latin cancer likewise meant crab and, in medical writers, the disease; it also named the zodiac sign.
items.cn: 拉丁语 cancer 同样兼指螃蟹与该病，并用于命名黄道星座。

items.en: Old English rendered the disease as cancer with native calyan; Middle English kept both senses alive.
items.cn: 古英语曾以本土词 calyan 对译此病；中古英语保留了疾病与星座两义。

items.en: From the eighteenth century oncology fixed cancer as the medical term, and the metaphoric social sense flourished.
items.cn: 十八世纪起肿瘤学将 cancer 固定为医学术语，社会比喻义也随之兴盛。

note.en: Cancer has a Greek twin in carcinoma and a family of crab words; spelling neighbors are few.
note.cn: cancer 在希腊语里有一个孪生词 carcinoma，还有一族「螃蟹」词；拼写近邻不多。

entries.definition: A cancer of epithelial tissue, from Greek karkinos plus -oma.
entries.definitionCN: 上皮组织来源的恶性肿瘤，出自希腊语 karkinos 加 -oma。
致癌物，同出 karkinos 词根。

entries.definition: An ulcerous sore or plant disease, an older English offshoot of the same word.
entries.definitionCN: 溃疡、植物的溃疡病，是同一个词更早的英语旁支。

entries.definition: An abnormal growth, which may be benign or malignant.
entries.definitionCN: 异常增生物，可为良性或恶性。

entries.definition: The quality of being life-threatening and invasive, as of a tumor.
entries.definitionCN: （肿瘤的）恶性；具侵袭性、危及生命的性质。

entries.definition: Something that withers or spoils, often used for urban or social decay.
entries.definitionCN: 枯萎病；比喻使衰败的祸害，常用于城市或社会语境。
瘟疫；比喻大范围的灾害或困扰。

entries.definition: A decrease or disappearance of cancer symptoms.
entries.definitionCN: （癌症的）缓解；症状减轻或消失，与恶化相对。

normalIntro.en: Five hooks on the crab image and the Greek-Latin twin family.
normalIntro.cn: 五条围绕「螃蟹」意象与希腊-拉丁孪生词族的记忆钩子。

normal.en: Literal root: cancer is Latin for crab, and a crab grips and spreads sideways.
normal.cn: 字面词根：cancer 是拉丁语「螃蟹」，螃蟹钳住不放、横着蔓延。

normal.en: Twin term: carcinoma is the Greek-branch word for epithelial cancer in medical writing.
normal.cn: 孪生术语：carcinoma 是医学文献里希腊一系的「上皮癌」用词。

normal.en: Zodiac link: the faint constellation Cancer sits between Gemini and Leo.
normal.cn: 星座关联：暗弱的巨蟹座位于双子座与狮子座之间。

normal.en: Figurative frame: a cancer on society is the standard metaphor in essays and speeches.
normal.cn: 比喻框架：a cancer on society 是文章与演说中的标准隐喻。

normal.en: Older cousin: canker, an ulcer or plant sore, preserves the medieval English form of the word.
normal.cn: 更老的表亲：canker（溃疡；植物溃疡病）保存了该词中古英语的形态。

abstract.en: A crab buried to the eyes in sand, claws spread wide, refusing to let go.
abstract.cn: 一只螃蟹埋沙到眼睛，双螯大张，说什么也不松开。

abstract.en: Ink dropped in water, its tendrils reaching into every corner of the glass.
abstract.cn: 一滴墨落入清水，触须伸向杯中每个角落。

abstract.en: A faint constellation of dim stars shaped like a claw, easy to miss, always there.
abstract.cn: 一个由暗星组成的爪形星座，容易错过，却始终悬在天空。

examples.en: Chemotherapy and radiation remain the standard weapons against advanced cancer.
examples.cn: 化疗和放疗仍是对付晚期癌症的标准武器。

examples.en: The essay described apathy as a cancer on public life.
examples.cn: 文章把冷漠描述为侵蚀公共生活的毒瘤。

examples.en: Born under Cancer, she jokes that she is crablike in arguments.
examples.cn: 她生于巨蟹座，常开玩笑说自己吵架时像螃蟹一样横。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「砍色」——面对肿瘤要毫不留情地砍，一点颜色都不留，正是与癌搏斗的画面；联想螃蟹横行钳物，癌细胞也在体内横行扩散。

root: 直接来自拉丁语 cancer（螃蟹），可上溯至印欧词根 *kar-（坚硬）。希腊医生认为肿瘤周围肿胀的血管像蟹腿，故以 karkinos（螃蟹）称病，拉丁语 cancer 沿用此义并随医学文献进入英语。carcinoma、carcinogen 同出希腊一系；canker 是本词的古老英语变体；巨蟹座也因蟹形得名。

sensesIntro.en: From the crab-named disease the word reaches into social criticism and back up to the sky as a zodiac sign.
sensesIntro.cn: 从以蟹命名的疾病出发，词义一头伸入社会批判的比喻，一头回到天上成为黄道星座。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a crab gripping and spreading sideways, never letting go.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只钳住不放、横向蔓延的螃蟹。

branches.en: THE WARD: the disease of uncontrolled cell growth.
branches.cn: 病房：细胞失控增生的疾病。

branches.en: THE EDITORIAL: corruption or decay described in the disease's image.
branches.cn: 社论：借疾病意象描写的腐败与衰败。

branches.en: THE EPHEMERIS: the zodiac sign named for the same crab.
branches.cn: 星历表：因同一只蟹得名的黄道宫。

branches.en: THE METAPHOR ENGINE: medical realism powering social rhetoric.
branches.cn: 隐喻引擎：医学的实感为社会修辞提供动力。

branches.en: THE TWO CRABS: one in the body, one in the sky, both from the same word.
branches.cn: 两只蟹：一只在体内，一只在天上，都出自同一个词。

intro.en: Cancer is a bare Latin noun; its derivational energy sits in the Greek branch kark- and in English suffixes added on top.
intro.cn: cancer 是光杆拉丁名词；其派生活动主要在希腊支系 kark- 与叠加其上的英语后缀。

latinIntro.en: The Latin cancer family is small; the wider medical family comes through Greek karkinos.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 cancer 词族不大；更大的医学词族经希腊语 karkinos 而来。

items.example: cancer and carcinoma are one word twice
items.exampleCN: cancer 与 carcinoma 实为同一词的两次借入。
希波克拉底文献中的 karkinos。

items.meaning: full of, having the quality of
items.meaningCN: 充满……性质的形容词后缀

items.example: tobacco smoke is a known carcinogen
items.exampleCN: 烟草烟雾是已知的致癌物。

items.meaning: the northern tropic at the sun's June turning point
items.meaningCN: 北回归线（太阳六月至点所在）
items.example: the Tropic of Cancer crosses Mexico

latinEntries.exampleCN: 巨蟹宫符号（拉丁语用例示意）。
